tasks.title: Establish the typed GFM parsing contract
tasks.dod: Unit tests prove that completed input is parsed with full GFM semantics, source positions survive normalization, and raw HTML is represented as text rather than executable structure.

tasks.title: Implement canonical sanitization and deterministic serializers
tasks.dod: Security and serializer unit tests prove the URL and structure policy, content-free positioned diagnostics, preview/source equivalence, and exact fragment and minimal-document output.

tasks.title: Add resilient latest-draft browser storage
tasks.dod: Adapter tests prove restore, replacement within the 500 ms autosave contract, profile isolation, tab-memory fallback, and removal of every application-controlled copy.

tasks.title: Add a typed dual-MIME clipboard adapter
tasks.dod: Adapter tests prove one confirmed write carries identical current HTML as text/plain and text/html and returns typed denial and failure outcomes.

tasks.title: Define disabled-by-default outcome telemetry
tasks.dod: Contract tests prove the disabled adapter emits nothing and the event type cannot accept Markdown, generated HTML, clipboard content, document URLs, or persistent identifiers.

tasks.title: Coordinate revision-matched conversion state
tasks.dod: State tests prove composition-safe updates, restore conversion, revision and mode freshness gates, Unicode code-point size warnings, and disabled copying for stale results.

tasks.title: Build the semantic converter workspace
tasks.dod: Component tests prove the editor, native output-mode controls, preview, selectable HTML panel, and copy freshness state render synchronized results and remain keyboard operable.

tasks.title: Expose sanitization and retention notices
tasks.dod: Component tests prove transformation totals and positioned categories expand without excerpts and persistent storage and oversize warnings are announced accessibly.

tasks.title: Complete copy and clear interaction recovery
tasks.dod: Component tests prove confirmed copy feedback, failure focus and manual selection, stale-copy blocking, and Clear removal from input, profile storage, and tab memory.

tasks.title: Compose the server-rendered converter route
tasks.dod: Route tests prove the Server Component page supplies metadata, preserves the skip link, and composes only the converter client island while all styles consume resolved global tokens.

tasks.title: Verify the complete browser workflow and accessibility
tasks.dod: Browser tests pass for edit, restore, mode switch, copy success and failure, Clear, sanitization disclosure, responsive layouts, keyboard navigation, and zero critical or serious accessibility violations.

tasks.title: Prove security and performance quality gates
tasks.dod: Automated browser suites prove unsafe fixtures never execute, copied MIME payloads match visible HTML, conversion p95 meets 100 ms through 100,000 code points, and cold initial usability meets 2 seconds under the specified profile.
